offering_description.value: Operates a digital health messaging network that delivers treatment, cost-savings and patient-support messages to healthcare providers and patients at the point of care. Sells mainly to pharmaceutical manufacturers, delivered through electronic health record and other healthcare technology integrations.

primary_products.value: digital health messaging platform; point-of-care patient engagement software; copay and affordability messaging tools

primary_services.value: pharma marketing campaigns; patient and provider messaging; data and analytics services

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and life sciences manufacturers, healthcare marketing agencies, health systems

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; life sciences; healthcare providers; digital health

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per message or campaign delivered through the network; project or contract: pharma client campaign contracts and sponsored programs
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs messaging network connected to EHRs, selling to pharma manufacturers and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: United States healthcare providers and patients

specialization.value: niche specialist: point-of-care digital health messaging and pharma engagement

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to pharma manufacturers and agencies; partners / resellers: EHR and healthcare technology partners delivering messages

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA patient privacy rules and FDA pharmaceutical promotion rules
